text: {"lessons":["Doing nothing avoided impulsive trades, but it did not prevent the account from falling; review whether each holding still fits a clear plan.","The rebound in periods 9 and 10 does not erase earlier losses or prove a trend, so I should not chase recent moves.","To judge whether I am meeting my goal, compare long-run results with the overall market and account for risk—not just individual monthly gains or losses."]}
